sections.h2: Where Trenton exteriors break down first
body: A house rarely fails evenly. On Trenton homes we see the same pattern: the bottom foot of siding stays wet from rain splash and lawn sprinklers, the west and south walls lose pigment years ahead of the north side, and trim joints open up as the wood swells and dries. Near Hart Springs and the Suwannee River corridor, shade adds algae and mildew to that list.

So instead of one square-foot rate for the whole house, our crew lead photographs each side during the walkthrough and writes repairs and product choices per elevation. That is the core of exterior painting in Trenton FL done right.

sections.h2: The coating system, surface by surface
bullets: Wood and fiber-cement siding, trim: premium 100% acrylic, two coats
Stucco with hairline movement: elastomeric that bridges small cracks
Doors and railings: waterborne urethane enamel
Exposed wood: penetrating stain instead of film-forming paint
Brick and masonry: a coating suited to the substrate, named on the estimate

body: Prep is scheduled as its own days: washing, scraping to a sound edge, sanding, mildew treatment, rot and fascia replacement, re-caulking, and priming bare spots. Sprayed coats are back-brushed or back-rolled where penetration matters. A full exterior generally takes three to seven working days plus wash and dry time.
October through May gives the most reliable drying weather. In summer we start early, keep an eye on dew point and radar, and stop before the afternoon storms roll in.

Where a Trenton house sits changes the plan. On a downtown lot, neighbors, vehicles, and sidewalks are close, so we bag shrubs, cover drives, and choose between spraying and rolling based on wind and clearance. Out on open homestead land, there is room to spray, but the sun hits every wall hard, so we put the most attention on the south and west elevations and may suggest a higher-grade product line only on those sides. Since the estimate is itemized, that kind of targeted upgrade is easy to see and approve.

Exterior work carries a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years in addition to the manufacturer's coverage, and you keep labelled touch-up paint. Washing is included in prep, but you can read more about our soft washing in Trenton. Homeowners doing inside and out together should look at full residential repaints in Trenton. Learn more on our exterior painting service page, the Trenton area page, or in how long exterior paint lasts in Florida.

faqs.q: Do you paint stucco and block homes in Trenton?
faqs.a: Yes. Stucco with hairline movement gets an elastomeric coating, and we repair cracks that need more than paint before coating.

faqs.q: Can you paint the outside of a house in summer?
faqs.a: Yes, with care. We work earlier in the day and monitor dew point and radar, though October through May is the preferred season.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on exterior paint?
faqs.a: Exterior projects carry a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, plus the manufacturer's product warranty.

faqs.q: Do I need to pressure wash before you arrive?
faqs.a: No. Washing and mildew treatment are part of our prep and appear on the estimate.
